Demonstrated experience designing and implementing process improvements that reduce operational inefficiencies, standardize procedures, and improve program outcomes and the employee experience.
Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in human resources, employment, or onboarding operations.

Must have demonstrated experience managing a team, driving process improvements, interpreting employment law and policy changes in an operational context, managing stakeholder relationships, and using performance data to assess and improve program outcomes.

Serves as the leader of the onboarding function, providing full strategic and operational oversight across all onboarding programs, processes, and personnel. Accountable for establishing and advancing the function's strategic direction, governance framework, and operational standards, while ensuring that programs evolve in alignment with organizational priorities, workforce trends, and regulatory requirements. Balances direct involvement in day-to-day operations with a forward-looking perspective, continuously identifying and implementing process improvements that streamline workflows, reduce inefficiencies, and elevate the overall quality of onboarding service delivery. Exercises sound professional judgment in reviewing and interpreting changes in federal, state, and organizational policy, and translates those changes into updated procedures and operational standards. Serves as a trusted advisor and key decision-maker on matters that impact the onboarding function, the employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.

The Onboarding team is responsible for delivering a seamless, compliant, and welcoming experience for all new hires and transitioning employees. The team partners closely with HR, hiring departments, legal, and organizational leadership to ensure that onboarding processes are effective, efficient, and aligned with organizational goals, applicable laws, and evolving best practices.

People Leadership & Team Development: Actively supports and develops team members by fostering a continuous learning environment centered on professional growth and capability building. Provides coaching and career development support to empower staff and promote internal advancement. Drives operational excellence by establishing clear performance expectations, measurable goals, and accountability standards. Empowers the team through strategic delegation, stretch assignments, and high-impact projects, providing the necessary resources, mentorship, and leadership to ensure team success and goal attainment.

Manages specific talent acquisition programs as they relate to the onboarding. Receives assignments in the form of objectives and determines how to manage and use professional recruiting staff and resources to meet schedules and goals. Oversees recruitment issues that are diverse in scope. Has interactions with internal and external contacts on issues of significance to the organization. Exercises strong judgment in interpreting and administering recruitment programs.
Must know organizational human resources policies and programs and budget / fiscal processes.

This position may be required to report at different work sites including Irvine, Orange, and other locations. The incumbent must be able to provide their own means of transportation to/from work locations.
Minimum of two (2) years in a supervisory or management role overseeing onboarding, employment services, or a related HR function.
Maintains a thorough understanding of the goals of the organization and ways in which this position can support those goals.

Ability to establish and maintain effective, trust-based relationships with a diverse range of organizational stakeholders, including HR partners, hiring departments, legal and compliance teams, and executive leadership, serving as a collaborative partner and credible subject matter expert.

Knowledge of applicable human resources policies and procedures, labor contracts and employment law, including the Americans With Disabilities Act and affirmative action / equal employment opportunity.
Requires leadership and effective management skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Demonstrated knowledge of onboarding processes, compliance requirements, and best practices, including applicable federal and state employment laws and regulations governing new hire procedures such as Form I-9/E-Verify, background screening requirements, and data privacy standards.

Proven ability to operate effectively at both the strategic and operational levels of an organization, transitioning fluidly between high-level planning and decision-making and hands-on involvement in day-to-day processes and problem resolution.

Strong client relationship management and service delivery skills, including the ability to handle complex or sensitive escalations with professionalism, manage special or non-standard requests, and maintain productive and positive relationships with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

Ability to monitor, interpret, and apply changes in law, regulation, and organizational policy as they relate to onboarding operations; skilled at translating compliance requirements into clear, practical guidance for operational teams.

Strong supervisory, coaching, and team development skills with the ability to set clear performance expectations, provide meaningful feedback, manage accountability, and promote a high-performance, service-oriented team culture.
